_about: Bracketology (NCAA men's tournament) settings. Every conference's automatic bid comes from simulating its tournament. autoBid: optional per-conference override - set a conference to 'placeholder' to give its regular-season standings leader the bid instead (kept as an escape hatch; none set). formatOverride: per season, a conference's tournament shape for a league whose last three tournaments no longer describe it - tiers are how many teams enter at each round, worst seeds first (so [2, 3, 2, 2] is an 8/9 play-in, seeds 5-7 enter next, 3-4 after that, 1-2 at the semifinals); 'announced' says whether the conference has published it or it's our provisional guess to replace once it has. selectionSunday: per season; a season not listed uses the Sunday on or after March 11.

ASUN.note: Provisional: 8 teams, Jacksonville, Mar 4-7 announced; bracket to be released. Assumes all 8, no byes.

Mountain West.note: All 10 teams, Thomas & Mack Center, Mar 10-13: top 6 bye to the quarterfinals.

Pac-12.note: All 9 teams, MGM Grand Garden Arena, Mar 9-13: 8/9 play-in; 1-2 double bye, 3-4 single bye.

SWAC.note: Top 10 of 12 qualify from 2027: 7v10 and 8v9; 5-6 enter round two, 3-4 the quarterfinals, 1-2 the semifinals.

Summit.note: All 8 teams (Denver left), Sioux Falls from Mar 4: opens with the quarterfinals; 14 games across the men's and women's events = 7 each, a straight 8-team bracket.

UAC.note: Provisional: 9 teams, Allen TX, Mar 10-14 announced; bracket to be released. Assumes an 8/9 play-in.

WCC.note: Provisional: 10 teams after Gonzaga, Oregon State and Washington State left; the old 12-team stepladder shortened by one tier. Nothing announced yet.
